definition: fraction of oracle calls spent on a FEASIBLE (in-constraint) candidate; wasted = 1 - efficiency
ours_mechanism: oracle (scored_qed) is called ONLY on in-fiber successors -- all feasibility checks (similarity/scaffold/substructure) precede scoring, so infeasible proposals are never scored
baseline: generate-then-filter must score every candidate before discarding; usable fraction = constraint-satisfaction fraction
